controls.required_evidence: Real hosted multithreaded fixture produces exactly 20 identity-bound samples; fixture counter advances while detached. This is not an OpenROAD run.
Compare actual GDB host LWP IDs with /proc/PID/task during all-stop; reject missing or duplicate threads and retain real unwind errors.
Fixture has distinct same-named host/target libraries; resolve /proc/PID/root and reject host substitution.
Actual system/home/local/executable auto-load canaries must not execute under -nx/-nh and early set auto-load off.
Controlled local endpoint receives zero requests; explicit off and empty URL environment are required.
On sacrificial fixture only, actual memory/register writes, inferior calls and breakpoint/tracepoint insertion are rejected.
Reject changed native starttime before attaching.
Reject changed ELF bytes/inode/device or exec after initial identity.
Reject changed container ID, image, StartedAt, cpuset, cmdline or cgroup.
Fixture exits and another PID is supplied; no original identity is inferred. Numeric attach race is rechecked while stopped.
Reject nonzero TracerPid before observer owns attachment.
Reject changed proc root/namespace identity before, during or after attachment.
Stopped-snapshot identity corruption rejects before frames are accepted.
Stall debugger fixture; deadline terminates only debugger group, proves TracerPid zero/no tracing stop, retains failure.
Inject trusted-reader exception after attach; finally detach and post-detach identity proof must run.
Debugger-wrapper fixture exits leaving descendant; supervisor rejects and cleans owned group before accepting output.
Missing detach acknowledgment or retained tracer/trace-stop rejects; no target rescue signal.
Nineteen samples cannot satisfy 20-sample acquisition.
Thread/frame/output/monotonic limits checked; excess reported explicitly rather than silently dropped.
Absent symbols/unwind failure retain addresses/module offsets and error; no fabricated complete stack.
Reject old40095811631 or changed40120760532 summary/parts/member/ELF/image/prefix.
Reproduce original no-log assertion site/code object; arbitrary exception or CPU activity cannot satisfy gate.
